translations.web: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
translations.bsb: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
translations.kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
